 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Brighton & Hove Albion look to build on their roaring form in Europe when they face FK Jablonec at Stadion Střelnice in the UEFA Conference League tonight.
 The Seagulls arrive in Czechia on a six-game winning streak across all competitions, most recently beating rivals Crystal Palace 5-0 in the Premier League. Fabian Hurzeler's side also made easy work of Kauno Zalgiris with a 4-0 win in their opening Conference league match and are heavy favorites to secure another positive result today.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jablonec, on the other hand, are coming off consecutive 3-2 defeats, first losing their European opener to Freiburg before losing to Viktoria Plzen in the Czech First league. However, they hold a seven-match unbeaten streak at home and will be a tough challenge for their Premier League opponents.
 Jablonec vs. Brighton Lineups
 Jablonec are without Kevin-Prince Milla, Krystof Karban, and Jan Suchan for today's match while Lamin Jawo is also heavily doubted after picking up a knock.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Leeds United's Brenden Aaronson (right) battles with Brighton & Hove Albion's Pascal Gross (left).Photo by David Horton - CameraSport via Getty Images
 Brighton too have a long injury list featuring Evan Ferguson, Stefanos Tzimas, Kaoru Mitoma, Mats Wieffer, Yankuba Minteh, and Femi Azeez. Pascal Struijk is also expected to sit out with a minor problem.
 Jablonec predicted starting lineup: 
 Hanus; Cedidla, Tekijaski, Pavlovic, Slama; Okeke, Sedlacek; Polidar, Alioum, Tchanturishvili; Rusek 
 Brighton & Hove Albion predicted starting lineup:  
 Verbruggen; Costinha, Svoboda, Dunk, Boscagli; Gross, O'Riley; Gomez, Hinshelwood, Osman; Rutter
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement How & Where to Watch Jablonec vs. Brighton Conference League Match
 Today's UEFA Conference League match is broadcast live on TNT Sports 2 and streamed via HBO Max in the UK. Kickoff takes place at 5:45 PM BST 
 Fans in the US can stream the action live on Paramount+ and ViX and kickoff is scheduled for 12:45 PM EDT.
